optimizations.name: signal_ehr_live_gate
optimizations.description: Auto-suspend live mode when 7-day rolling signal EHR drifts below 0 on 50+ bets. Protective circuit breaker one abstraction layer above the 5-loss / $300-daily rails. Added 2026-04-21 after FAK pilot on btc_5m took −$159 on day 1 — the signal EHR had silently drifted from +0.035 to −0.082 over 48h and we didn't catch it before going live. Paper mode is unaffected (we want paper to keep generating predictions for monitoring). Implemented in src/system_state.py::get_system_state — a new blocker in state.blockers when the conditions hold.
optimizations.revert_condition: if the gate fires when signal_ehr_7d between -0.005 and 0 (flapping at threshold) causing frequent live/paper toggles, add a hysteresis band (e.g., re-enable only when ehr >= +0.01 for 24h)

baseline.note: FAK fill rate validated at 90% (success). FAK filled WR 11% — execution improvement does not rescue a negative-EHR signal. This gate ensures future live activations require a verified-healthy signal.

optimizations.name: shadow_maker_phase_1
optimizations.description: Shadow maker Phase 1. Every conv>=3 prediction logs a hypothetical passive maker order (mid ± 0.25×spread) alongside the real taker decision. Measures fill rate, adverse selection, and shadow EHR. Goal: validate whether passive posting closes the 60-point adverse-selection gap seen in historical GTC+FOK live data (filled WR 35% vs unfilled WR 95%). Promotion to Phase 2 (real maker orders) gated on shadow_ehr > taker EHR on 200+ fills.
optimizations.revert_condition: shadow_ehr <= taker_ehr on 200+ resolved fills, OR fill_rate < 30% (maker orders don't fill often enough to matter)

baseline.note: Apr 18 first real data: BTC 19 filled at 52.6% adverse (shadow_ehr +0.023); ETH 36 filled at 63.9% adverse (shadow_ehr -0.099). BTC needs execution help, ETH has signal problem.

optimizations.name: arb_llm_classifier
optimizations.description: LLM-based classifier for arb_divergence rows, called manually at Phase 0 decision gate. Per docs/plans/groovy-squishing-scott.md D1#1: aggregate divergence counts alone cannot distinguish (a) lag (tractable arb), (b) model_error (tractable model refinement), (c) adverse_selection (untradable), (d) other. The four classes have opposite Go/Abandon implications despite identical raw numbers. Module src/arb_classifier.py samples N high-edge rows and asks DO Serverless Inference to pick one class per row with rationale+confidence. Aggregate class distribution feeds Phase 0 Go/Abandon. Shadow: calibration logged via llm_calibration_log; comparison to ground truth at market resolution.
optimizations.revert_condition: on the first 50 classifications with ground-truth outcomes available at market resolution: if LLM-class vs actual-outcome agreement rate < 60% for the 'lag' class (LLM says lag => market should resolve consistent with bybit direction within the window), the classifier is noise — do not use for Phase 0 decision; rely on per-regime raw counts only

baseline.trigger: Phase 0 decision gate (≥48h + regime coverage met)
baseline.no_bias_constraint: schema explicitly excludes buy/sell/direction; classifier names CAUSE only, never action
baseline.note: First real calibration happens when Phase 0 reaches the decision gate — shadow until then. Manual entry point: python3 -m arb_classifier --n 50 --min-edge 0.02.

optimizations.name: v4_decay_llm_diagnosis
optimizations.description: One-shot LLM diagnosis of V4 momentum decay. Per docs/plans/groovy-squishing-scott.md D1#2: assembles a deterministic bundle (per-day/per-regime win rates, regime timeline) from predictions.db over a user-specified window, sends to DO Serverless Inference with a structured-output schema, renders markdown to docs/analysis/. Schema requires onset_date_hypothesis, regime_correlation, news_correlation, decay_vs_reverting (decaying|reverting|ambiguous), confidence (low|medium|high), recommended_action (continue|restrict|pivot|wait). Output is a PRIOR to compare against independent quant analysis, NOT a source of truth. Feeds the 2026-04-28 pivot commitment decision.
optimizations.revert_condition: n/a — one-shot analysis, not a live signal path; if the output disagrees sharply with independent quant read AND the quant read is later vindicated, the diagnosis is noise for this class of question and should not be re-run without prompt iteration

baseline.no_bias_constraint: schema excludes buy/sell; LLM names onset + regime correlation + action class only

optimizations.name: multi_poll_predict_logger
optimizations.description: Phase A of in-cycle prediction-timing study. After each Bybit 5m candle close, fires 9 additional predict() calls at offsets T+30s through T+270s (every 30s) and logs each to multi_poll_predictions table. Pure shadow — no behavior change for capital, conviction gating, or trade execution. Plan: docs/plans/multi_poll_predict_plan.md. Triggered by signal_rehab_2026-04-28 finding that the Apr 5 dispatch refactor (f79e56f21) sharply reduced lab WR from ~60% to ~50% by removing ~2:30 of in-flight candle data that GHA scheduling delays had been picking up. This experiment makes the in-cycle information curve measurable so Phase B can decide whether a delayed (or regime-adaptive) dispatch policy recovers the lost edge.
optimizations.revert_condition: after 14 days of observation: if no offset shows ≥2pp WR over the immediate-dispatch (offset=0) baseline on N≥100 per cell across at least 4 (offset × regime) cells, the in-flight information edge is not recoverable as a time-based policy. Document and close as 'no edge'. Phase C does not ship.

baseline.trigger: automatic — fires every 5m bybit_spot close for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT
baseline.expected_volume_per_day: 9 polls × ~10 active markets × 288 cycles = ~26k rows/day per asset
baseline.no_capital_risk: shadow only — does not feed conviction gates or trade execution
baseline.phase_b_decision: after observation: tools/multi_poll_analysis.py computes WR per (offset × regime × asset) cell. Three outcomes: (1) single offset wins clearly → ship as new policy in Phase C; (2) regime-adaptive optimum → ship policy table; (3) no edge → close out, V4 chapter ends
baseline.phase_c_gating: if Phase C ships, signal_ehr_live_gate still controls live capital. Multi-poll ships dispatch timing only.
baseline.post_incident_discipline: RETENTION_DAYS=30 hardcoded in module from day 1. Lessons from 2026-04-24 disk-full incident: retention-in-code, not in a never-wired cron.
